## FAQs
## 01How to join the campaign and qualify for rewards?
## 02How does the lucky draw in Activity 1 work?
Trade 10,000 USDT daily for consecutive days to earn lucky draw entries. Each draw guarantees rewards, including TradFi token airdrops or Trial Funds.
## 03Are rewards from all activities stackable?
Yes. Rewards from Activities 1, 2, and 3 can be earned simultaneously.
## Terms and conditions
1. Users must register on the campaign page to participate.
2. This campaign is available in selected countries and regions only. Successful registration confirms eligibility for participation and rewards.
3. This campaign supports market orders, lightning close positions, and market take profit/stop loss orders only.
4. Only self-directed trades are eligible, and Copy Trading is not supported.
5. All rewards will be distributed within 7 business days after the campaign ends. Rewards from all activities can be earned simultaneously.
6. Rewards for Activity 1 and Activity 2 will be provided as Trial Funds, valid for 14 days. When used, they are applied 50/50 alongside the user’s own funds.
7. Rewards from Activity 3 will be distributed in selected TradFi tokens. The final reward value will be based on the token price at the campaign’s end. Market fluctuations may cause slight differences in the actual token amount received.
8. Trades using Bonuses or Trial Funds do not count toward the actual liquidation amount.
9. Users must comply with Toobit’s Terms of Service. The following actions will result in immediate disqualification: batch account registration, wash trading, self-trading, or other similar actions.
10. Users with multiple accounts on the same IP address or UID will be disqualified.
11. In the event of any discrepancies, the English version of this announcement shall prevail.
12. Toobit reserves the final right of interpretation for this campaign. If you have any questions, please reach out to us via live chat or submit a ticket through the Support Center on our official website or app.

ANNOUNCEMENT / RULES:
Thanksgiving & Black Friday season just went live on BTSE—with $220,000 in rewards on the table. 🦃🔥
Sign up for a shot at AirPods Max 2. Check in daily to grab up to $88. Stack up to $218 in task rewards, and trade your way to an iPhone Duo.

👉🏻 Come get yours
## On the exchange page
Black Friday: Split $220,000!
Sign Up to Win AirPods Max 2, Level Up for iPhone Duo!
Event Period: November 24th, 2026 08:00 - December 15th, 2026 23:59 (UTC+0)
How to Join
Click "Join Now" to register.
Complete tasks to earn rewards.

Terms and Conditions
1.Click "Join Now" on the campaign page to register. Only actions completed after successful registration will be counted toward campaign results.
2.New users are those who register during the campaign period. Users who registered before the campaign starts are considered existing users.
3.Net deposit = total deposits − total withdrawals during the campaign period. Participants must deposit USDT on-chain. Internal transfers and non-designated currencies will not be counted toward campaign results.
4.Cumulative trading volume is the sum of spot and futures trading volume during the campaign period. Trading Volume = Total executed Buy Orders + Total executed Sell Orders. Futures trading volume = total executed buy orders + total executed sell orders (leverage included). Trading using vipUSDT or similar vouchers will not be counted toward the trading volume.
5.Task 1: Account assets refer to the total value of assets in your BTSE account, converted to USDT. The system will take a snapshot of user assets before rewards are distributed. Registered users who do not meet the account asset requirement will forfeit their sign-up reward, and the slot will pass to the next eligible user in line. To enter the lucky draw, you must register for the campaign and meet the account asset requirement.To enter the lucky draw, you must register for the campaign and meet the account asset requirement.
6.Task 2: Each check-in task must be completed on its designated date. Tasks completed after that date will not be counted. Each user may claim one reward per check-in day.
7.Task 3: A trading day is counted when your total trading volume (spot + futures) reaches ≥ $500 within a calendar day.
8.Task 4: Only the highest level reached will be rewarded; rewards from different levels cannot be stacked. vipUSDT and USDT rewards within the same level can both be received. If the slots for your level are full, you will receive the reward for the next level down.
9. Kindly note that participation does not guarantee a reward, and rewards valued under 1 USDT will not be distributed.
10. The gift box consists of a combination of vipUSDT, Bonus, BTSE Cash or token airdrops of equivalent value. Actual rewards are subject to the amounts credited to your account.
11. Physical prizes (AirPods Max 2, iPhone 18 Pro, iPhone Duo) will be arranged and distributed by BTSE after the campaign ends. Due to differing logistics policies and product restrictions in various regions, physical prizes may be adjusted to equivalent tokens or other forms based on availability. The specific form will depend on the actual distribution plan.
12. Please redeem and use rewards within the validity period; expired rewards are automatically forfeited. See the Rewards Hub for details.
13. Rewards will be distributed within 14 business days after the campaign ends. The actual token received will be subject to the final distribution.
14. BTSE may disqualify participants and restrict accounts for abnormal activity, including bulk registration, wash trading, or multi-account participation.
15. Campaign trades must be made via your main account. Main and sub-accounts are treated as one account, with data combined.
16. To ensure fairness, market maker accounts and BTSE employees are not eligible for campaign rewards.
17. Digital asset trading involves risk. Participate with caution. BTSE is not liable for any losses arising from participation.
18. BTSE may suspend or end this campaign early due to technical issues, abnormal market conditions, force majeure, or legal requirements, with notice on the platform.
19. The campaign is unavailable in restricted jurisdictions, as defined in BTSE’s Terms of Use and platform announcements.
20. BTSE may modify campaign rules as needed, as announced on the campaign or platform pages. BTSE reserves the right of final interpretation.
